private_lines.Saima: You live in Karachi, work as a physiotherapist, and live alone.
private_lines.Shahid: You live in Karachi, run a hardware shop, and live alone.

text: Ok which chapter does everyone want to start with for the 20th. I'll bring the book with post its 📖
Ch 4 for me. The dinner scene with the uncle, I want to argue about it
Also I have some thoughts on the ending but that's for later
Ch 7
7 ok. Zara?
Still on shift till tmrw morning so my brain is mush. Ch 2 maybe, its short
Ch 2 is good, short is good
Venue. Last time at the cafe we couldnt hear anything over the coffee machine. My place upstairs is free that sunday, we can do it there
Not cooking, promise. Just chai
Chai is fine. What time
7 or 7:30? I have a client at 9 am the next day so not too late pls
7:30 then. Fans work upstairs now I fixed the one
Got a shipment of pipe fittings today, 200 pieces, sorted them all by hand because the new boy cant count. Back aching
Ouch. Ice it
Ice is for old men saima 😂
Just got out. 14 hrs. Someone's granddad coded in bay 3 and we got him back which is good but I need to sleep for a week
So glad he made it. Sleep
[photo: draft of the new winter menu, the nihari is mine]
Tell me honestly is the chai on the back page too much
Its not too much. The price is though 😅
The price is a crime
Cant sleep. Reread ch 4 and the uncle is worse than I remembered. 7:30 for the 20th still?
Yes 7:30. Go to sleep asif
Clinic opens at 9 so I'm off. Shahid how's the back today
Better. Slept on the floor like a monk 😂
Dont tell the doctor I said that
Ch 4 again. The uncle makes the whole dinner about money and nobody at the table calls him on it. I want someone to call him on it
Thats the point of the chapter though
Yes but still
Shop is quiet. Man came in for one bolt and bought a whole toolbox
Up. Barely. Did anyone finish ch 2 or is it just me
Half. Its really short though, you can do it tonight
Ok. Dont tell me the ending
I wasnt going to
(I was going to)
[photo: the nihari pot, 6pm, the whole lane smells of it]
Lunch crowd thought it was Eid
Closing up. Fittings are all still in the back, the boy counted 12 and then gave up
Finished ch 2. Post its everywhere
Zara you will have to explain the thing with the letter to me
Going to sleep at 9 like a grandmother. Will read tmrw on the bus
Tmrw being Tuesday which I am not on shift for, miracle
Anyone else think the ending is cheating
Not tonight Asif
Ok ok
Still thinking about the uncle. Going to bed for real this time
Bus is full of school kids singing at the top of their lungs. Reading anyway
Brave
Shop open. Boy is here, recounted the fittings. 200 is 200 he says now
Supplier wants to double the lamb price for January. Telling him no. Telling him maybe
Going to be a long week
Finished 2. Ok, the letter. Saima I'll explain at the club, its easier to point at it
Fine. Dont make me wait till the 20th
Clinic lunch was a samosa and a patient with opinions about my shoes. Fair opinions
[photo: supplier invoice, lamb line circled in red]
This is what I am dealing with
Ask him for the bulk rate. Everyone asks for bulk rate
Already asked. He laughed
Slept 3 hrs and now awake for no reason. Ch 2 is sitting in my head. The letter writer is not who I thought
Ok not saying anything else
Good
Back is fine. Heating pad from the medical store. Saima dont look at me like that
I didn't say anything
Ending is cheating. I'm going to say it again at the club so its on record
Ok I'm done
Its on record
Power cut on our street just now. Hospital has generators, I'm told the lane is dark
Power cut here too. Candles in the kitchen. Nihari is in the fridge, its fine
Not a single customer in the dark, they all went home
Gen is on at the shop. Sitting in it with the fans
Going to sleep. Not on the floor
